name: git-portable
description: Self-contained portable Git that carries its own https/libcurl runtime and resolves every DLL from its own tree, so it works identically on MSYS2, Git-for-Windows, and Cygwin with no dependency on the host runtime

git.description: Git distributed version control system, self-contained with its own bundled runtime (libcurl closure verified via dependency analysis)
git.usage:
git clone https://host/repo.git # Clone over https (bundled libcurl)
git init # Initialize repository
git commit -m 'message' # Commit changes
git push origin main # Push to remote
git pull # Pull latest changes

git-lfs.description: Git Large File Storage extension for versioning large binary files efficiently
git-lfs.usage:
git lfs install # Initialize LFS in repository
git lfs track '*.psd' # Track large file types
git lfs ls-files # List tracked files
git lfs pull # Download LFS objects
